name: Olaparib
mechanism_of_action: Traps PARP1/2 at single-strand DNA breaks, inducing lethal double-strand breaks in HR-deficient cells.

name: Osimertinib
mechanism_of_action: Irreversibly binds EGFR kinase domain with high selectivity for exon 19 del, L858R, and T790M resistance mutations.

name: Trastuzumab
mechanism_of_action: Binds extracellular domain IV of HER2, blocking ligand-independent dimerization and triggering ADCC.

name: Metformin
mechanism_of_action: Inhibits mitochondrial complex I, elevating AMP/ATP ratio to activate AMPK and curb hepatic gluconeogenesis.

name: Semaglutide
mechanism_of_action: Mimics glucagon-like peptide-1, stimulating glucose-dependent insulin secretion and delaying gastric emptying.

name: Pembrolizumab
indication: Lung Cancer, Melanoma, MSI-H Colorectal Cancer
mechanism_of_action: Blocks PD-1 interaction with PD-L1/PD-L2, releasing T cell exhaustion and restoring antitumor cytotoxicity.

name: Sotorasib
indication: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Colorectal Cancer
mechanism_of_action: Covalently locks KRAS G12C in its inactive GDP-bound conformation, suppressing downstream RAF-MEK-ERK signaling.

name: Palbociclib
mechanism_of_action: Selectively inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, maintaining retinoblastoma protein in hypophosphorylated state to halt G1/S transition.

name: Vemurafenib
mechanism_of_action: Potently and selectively inhibits the kinase activity of the mutated BRAF V600E monomer.

name: Adalimumab
mechanism_of_action: Neutralizes soluble and transmembrane TNF-alpha, dampening the pro-inflammatory cytokine cascade.

name: Tocilizumab
mechanism_of_action: Competitively inhibits binding of IL-6 to both soluble and membrane-bound IL-6 receptors.

name: Venetoclax
mechanism_of_action: Selectively binds BH3-binding groove of anti-apoptotic BCL-2, displacing BIM to execute mitochondrial apoptosis.

name: Evolocumab
mechanism_of_action: Inhibits PCSK9 binding to LDL receptors, preventing LDLR degradation and accelerating LDL clearance.

name: Ivacaftor
mechanism_of_action: Increases open probability of the gating-defective CFTR channel pore, augmenting chloride transport across epithelia.

name: Lecanemab
mechanism_of_action: Preferentially binds soluble amyloid-beta protofibrils and facilitates microglial phagocytic clearance.

name: Bevacizumab
mechanism_of_action: Binds circulating VEGFA isoforms, suppressing endothelial cell mitogenesis and tumor neo-angiogenesis.

name: Elacestrant
mechanism_of_action: Binds ER-alpha and induces its degradation, effectively overcoming ESR1 ligand-binding domain resistance mutations.

name: Alpelisib
mechanism_of_action: Selectively inhibits the p110alpha catalytic subunit of PI3K, reducing phosphorylation of AKT.
